name: claude-api
tagline_zh: 写代码时总忘 Opus 价格？调参前先翻它。模型 ID、流式、缓存、迁移，一查即用，连 one-liner 也别跳。
tagline_en: Forget Opus pricing mid-code? Check this before tweaking params. Model IDs, streaming, caching, migration—one.
desc_en: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration. TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.ant
why_zh: 同类工具只列文档链接，它把触发规则写进描述，逼你在打开文件前先读，避免因小失大。
why_en: Unlike doc-link lists, it bakes a trigger rule into the description, forcing a pre-read before file access—prevents costly.
